title: Prototypes
description: Prototypes shared by the functions. A function refers to one of them with `proto_ref` ([Interfaces](interfaces.md)). The generator derives from the prototype the C signatures, the C++ overloads, the LMUL > 1 versions built from two halves and the scalar fallback. The names follow the pattern `ret_<return>_<n>args_<arguments>`.

param.description: A return value or an argument.

type.description: Kind of value: `reg` (data register), `msk` (mask register), `val` (scalar), `ptr` (pointer to elements), `Nele` (array of one scalar per lane), or `false` for a `void` return.

fixeddatatype.description: `false`: the value has the datatype of the function. Otherwise its type is fixed: a datatype (`int32` for a shift count, `uint32`, ...) or a category (`uint`: the unsigned type of the same size, for the indices of gather and scatter).

charac.description: `RO`: read only, the argument is `const` in the signatures. `WO`: written (return values, stored pointers).

offset_lmul.description: Pointers only. When a function with LMUL > 1 is built from two calls on halves, the pointer of the second call is advanced by one half. `false` passes the same pointer to both calls (gather and scatter, whose indices give the offsets). Omitted: `true`.
